description: Announces a file on this machine to Audivo, uploads it, and returns its upload_id, for transcribe or for a quote of several uploads. transcribe with path does both steps. The file must be audio you hold rights to. Spends nothing. Local server only.

content_type.description: Required when the container is not recognised.

declared_duration_seconds.description: Required when the container states no duration.

path.description: Absolute path to the audio file on this machine.

title.description: A label; defaults to the file.

name: upload_audio
title: Upload an audio file (local only)
